model_decisions.hypothesis: The historical holding-speed gap (development 0.00728 m/s vs fresh confirmation 0.04741 m/s, 6.5x, at unchanged terminal error 0.003403 m and holding position 0.00382 m) shows the binding limitation is residual tip kinetic energy / slow decay at the held configuration, not reach accuracy or static force feasibility (both braking preflights were feasible_in_local_model). Therefore the design lever to test is the spectral damping margin of the arm linearized at the held (target) configuration: a structure with a larger held-position_min_eigenvalue margin should decay hold-window perturbations faster. This search only model-selects a structural change; it cannot establish dynamic holding improvement.
model_decisions.interpretation: Search output is a model-selected structural candidate and a directional expectation only. It is not acceptance, not confirmation, and does not establish dynamic holding improvement; a 1e-9 m class residual or a larger controllability score would not either. Any claim requires a fresh backend execution of the selected structure under the current NMPC recipe, then two fresh confirmations.

model_decisions.expected_observation: A feasible proxy candidate set whose members differ structurally from the reference in section scale and/or material, with at least one member whose held-position_min_eigenvalue (or feasible_then_max_normalized_violation_then_sum_v1 ranking score) differs from the reference by more than the protocol comparison tolerance (atol 1e-8, rtol 2e-6), giving a directional structural change (stiffer/softer section or material) to carry into an actual backend evaluation.
model_decisions.weakening_observation: All evaluated candidates are infeasible, or every feasible candidate's held-position eigenvalue margin is indistinguishable from the reference within atol 1e-8 / rtol 2e-6, i.e. the held-position spectrum is insensitive to section scale and material over the declared bounds and no model-selected structural direction exists.

model_decisions.hypothesis: The observed holding-speed gap (same candidate: development 0.00728 m/s passed vs fresh confirmation 0.04741 m/s failed, terminal error unchanged at 0.003403 m) is a hold-window residual-kinetic-energy / decay-rate limitation, not a reach or static-force limitation. The task-local-v2 target-equilibrium linearization ranks distal1_material=compliant as the model-selected structural change (held_position_min_eigenvalue 61.206 vs reference 58.950, +3.8%, above comparison rtol 2e-6), so extra held-position authority should let the current research_work_v1 NMPC damp the hold-window motion below 0.02 m/s. This proxy cannot establish dynamic holding; only this actual backend evaluation can measure it.
model_decisions.interpretation: This is the actual evaluation of a model-selected structural change and is the structural-milestone evaluation. A pass here is a fresh passing development in this study for the compliant-distal1 design and would license freezing the configuration and then two fresh confirmations; a failure closes the compliant-distal1 direction and licenses no improvement attribution. Historical development/confirmation numbers, the +3.8% proxy margin and the feasible braking preflights remain evidence only and cannot satisfy acceptance or confirmation.
model_decisions.expected_observation: A fresh complete MuJoCo execution (35 applied control updates, 0 force-bound violations, solver_error_count 0) with inclusive 6-sample holding coverage in [0.30,0.35] s reporting holding_max_speed_m_s and holding/terminal position error. If the model-selected direction is adequate, holding_max_speed_m_s is below 0.02 m/s with a recorded margin and terminal/holding error below 0.01 m, which would be the fresh passing development for a structurally changed design.
model_decisions.weakening_observation: holding_max_speed_m_s stays at or above the 0.02 m/s gate (e.g., ~0.04 m/s, as in the historical confirmation) while position remains inside tolerance, i.e. the +3.8% held-position authority change does not remove the hold-window speed violation; or the execution returns incomplete evidence, non-zero solver errors, force-bound violations, or missing holding samples, in which case no conclusion about the structural change is drawn.

model_decisions.hypothesis: The fresh passing development (holding_max_speed 0.017345 m/s, 13.3% inside the 0.02 m/s gate; terminal and holding position error 0.003081 m, 3.2x inside the 0.01 m gate; solver_errors 0; force-bound violation 0.0 N) reflects the frozen compliant-distal1 configuration under a non-timed research_work_v1 stopping policy rather than timed-return luck, because the historical confirmation failure (0.04741 m/s vs development 0.00728 m/s at unchanged terminal error 0.003403 m) arose under historical_timed_v1 with a 15 s feasible-return budget and max_cpu_s 30, which are disabled here (feasible_return null, max_cpu_s null). Hence two fresh independent executions should reproduce the pass.
model_decisions.interpretation: A pass in both fresh confirmations gives this study a fresh, design-and-control result with 2/2 independent confirmations for the model-selected structural change (distal1 compliant) and closes the confirmation gate. Any failure is retained without repetition and licenses no holding or improvement claim; the selection would then be revised only with a new fresh passing development and revise_selection=true, preserving all costs and selection history. Report task performance only: no structural-superiority, robustness, hardware, real-time or global-optimality claim is made, and historical evidence, the +3.8% held-position eigenvalue margin and the feasible braking preflights are not acceptance evidence.
model_decisions.expected_observation: Both fresh independent executions complete (execution_complete true, 0 solver errors, 0 force-bound violations, 6/6 inclusive holding samples) with every acceptance component passed, i.e. holding_speed < 0.02 m/s and terminal/holding position error < 0.01 m in each, giving 2/2 current-study confirmations for the frozen compliant-distal1 solution.
